resources.string: Ride by effort: big zone-colored number and Ride, Effort, Climb, Segment, Pace, Fuel, Weather, Lap, Analysis, Results, Workout, Bike and Coach panels. Put it alone on a page; tap the top to switch power/speed/HR, tap left or right of the panel to flip.
Wind compass that turns with your heading: green tailwind, red headwind, yellow crosswind.
W′ balance in kJ (Skiba model, CP from your FTP unless set in KarooPro).
Headwind (+) or tailwind (-) for your direction of travel, from Open-Meteo.
How long your W′ lasts at your current 3 s power. Empty while you ride at or below CP.
Crosswind from either side for your direction of travel, from Open-Meteo.
Your best 20 minute power so far this ride.

KarooPro\'s panels without the big top, for the map page or any short slot. The big number is the first slide; tap left or right to flip, the middle to switch the big number. It keeps its own slide, apart from the full KarooPro field.
A slim row of KarooPro values for map and data pages: W′ balance, stamina, wind, carbs, and climb, segment and workout values when they matter.
